prompt: Artist page header for /artist/<name>: renders the page h1 and a real portrait or artwork beside a Wikipedia biography.
shortDesc: The /artist/<name> page header from just the name, e.g. <g-artist-profile artist="Claude Monet"></g-artist-profile> (artist = the decoded URL segment as-is: %20 and + become spaces). It renders the page h1 (the artist's name) itself, so don't add a level="1" section. It shows the real portrait (Wikipedia), or one of the artist's own works clearly captioned and linked, or a monogram (never a generated image), then a short description, life dates, the Wikipedia biography clamped with 'Read more', and an attribution link. Put it first in <main>, followed by <g-page-section heading="Works"><g-artwork-grid artist="<same name>"></g-artwork-grid></g-page-section> (one shared request). Unknown names show a not-found message with a search link by themselves.

props.name: artist
props.description: Artist name, the decoded /artist/<name> segment as-is, e.g. "Claude Monet" or "Katsushika Hokusai". Use exactly the same value as the g-artwork-grid artist= below it so they share one request.

styling.tailwindClasses: block bg-white border-b border-stone-200 px-4 py-7 md:px-8 md:py-12 grid md:grid-cols-[280px_1fr] gap-7 md:gap-10 max-w-[1240px] mx-auto
styling.notes: VITRINE kit. A --paper band with a hairline bottom rule. Left: a 3:4 frame with a 1px --rule border (portrait object-fit cover; fallback artwork contained on a --mat with 7% padding and a soft drop-shadow; monogram in Newsreader 64px --gilt-ink inside a gilt inset hairline). Right: an oxblood 'ARTIST' kicker, an h1 in Newsreader 500 clamp(40px,6vw,60px), the description in 18px --soft, 'LIFE 1840–1926' in tabular nums, a 48px gilt rule, then the biography in Newsreader 18px/1.65 at 65ch, clamped to 7 lines with a fade and an oxblood 'Read more' button, and a 'Biography from Wikipedia ↗ · Text CC BY-SA 4.0' label line. On phones it stacks with the image first, 260px wide.

interactions.trigger: Mount or artist attribute change (shared with g-artwork-grid artist=, byte-identical body from the kit's READS.artist)
